AC10 required the timer to be 'cleared on shutdown alongside the others'. Verified against the module: there is no clearInterval in scripts/supervisor.ts at all, and every loop is unref'd instead. The criterion described a convention that does not exist, so it demanded either a false confirmation or a change that would make Loop 9 the odd one out. Reworded to the convention actually in use.
